text:
Ava: Quick design question — the timeline hover currently shows a tooltip with variant details + quick actions (Inspect, Pause). It feels clickable but is hover-only. Concerned about keyboard and screen reader discoverability. Screenshot: https://imgur.com/xyz (mock) Sam: Totally — hover-only actions are invisible to keyboard users. We should make the actionable area focusable. Maybe convert the actions into a focusable popover/panel. Also microcopy thought: 'Inspect variant' -> 'Open variant details'? Ravi: Engineering note: making tooltips focusable/popovers increases DOM complexity and can create focus traps if not careful. We can ship a focusable panel, but need clear close behavior, ESC handling, and ensure it plays nicely with timeline virtualization. Marta: From an a11y POV: it must be reachable via keyboard and announced properly. If it’s a list of actions, role="menu" is appropriate. If it’s a details pane with context + controls, use role="dialog" (aria-modal="false"). Also add aria-controls/aria-expanded on the trigger. Ava: Proposed compromise: keep the hover tooltip for quick glance only (non-interactive), but add a persistent inline "Preview" button on each variant chip that opens a keyboard-accessible panel with actions. Hover still shows summary; actions live in the panel. Sam: :thumbsup: I like the split quick-glance vs manage approach. For copy: "Preview" vs "Open variant details" — which is clearer for users? Marta: Use copy to set expectation. "Preview" implies transient read-only view. If the panel includes controls (Pause/Rollback) call it "Variant details" or "Manage variant". For SR announcement use something like: "Variant details for v1.2, 25% traffic, opened". Ravi: Implementation plan sketch: make an inline button with tabindex=0 that opens a rendered panel (not only CSS). Need aria-controls and aria-expanded toggled on open/close. Example snippet: ```
``` Ava: For the panel header copy I'd use: "Variant details — v1.2 (25% traffic)". For the action label, prefer changing "Pause rollout" to "Pause variant" to be explicit about scope. Sam: Agreed on "Pause variant". Also confirm modal copy for pause confirmation: "Pause traffic to this variant?" + clear primary/destructive button labels. Marta: Confirmation modal should be role="alertdialog" and trap focus. Use concise confirm text and ensure SR reads the variant id + percent in the message. deploy-bot: New design patch uploaded to Figma: https://figma.com/file/abcd1234/rollout-hover-preview-v3 (version: hover-preview-v3) Ava: Thanks — I’ll update the prototype to match these ARIA hints and copy changes and ping @Marta and @Ravi for a quick review tomorrow.
